turns.patient_opening: Hi. I’m 74, and I’ve been having a fever and a cough, plus a burning pain that feels like it’s in my face and head. I have pain in my forehead, right cheek, and both temples, and it also radiates toward my nose and the back of my head. I’d rate the pain about 3 out of 10, and it started pretty fast—like within a short time—and I also have greenish/yellow nasal discharge.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have polyps in your nose (nasal polyps)?
turns.patient_answer: Yes, I’ve had polyps in my nose before.

turns.doctor_question: Do you have asthma, or have you ever had to use a bronchodilator (like an inhaler) in the past?
turns.patient_answer: No, I don’t have asthma, and I haven’t needed to use a bronchodilator or inhaler in the past.

turns.doctor_question: Have you lost your sense of smell, or noticed that things don’t smell the way they used to? (Yes or no)
